grounding_note: 11 of 11 quoted claims were verified against the source text.

claims.claim: Office managers spend about 5 hours a week on ordering and invoice reconciliation.
Interviewed practices reported 3 critical-item stockouts per quarter.
The rep's suggested order is the default because nobody checks it.
Office managers accept rep orders without comparing prices.
Most interviewed practices buy from multiple distributors.
The spreadsheet process depends on a single person.
Distribution is concentrated in two national distributors with their own portals.
DSO consolidation squeezes independent practices on price.
Cairnly has 5 paying customers at $249 per location per month.
The 11% savings figure comes from internal data on five practices.
The CEO has dental group operations experience relevant to purchasing.
Distributors that run their own portals may resist a third party routing orders across catalogs, which would threaten the wedge.
